provenance.index_sha256_note: The baseline review packet did not retain the serialized Faiss index hash.

selection.method: Minimize the union of versioned chunk identities among 40 distinct questions with a multi-start overlap search, one-for-one swaps, and partial rebuilds. Order the strongest set found to favor shifted matches in leading evidence on earlier requests.
selection.replay_scope: Opportunity counts use identical versioned evidence token segments and archived retrieval order. Leading evidence stops at the first chunk unseen on that worker. GPU restore and repair are measured in replay.
